name: Index with links
description: The field-weighted lexical hits of the specification index plus the solutions and implementations each hit links to (a linked record scores half of the hit that brought it), summed per solution, keeping those near the best.
advantages: A problem, metric or ideal that matched brings its solution; free, deterministic and fast.
disadvantages: Finds nothing for a text that shares no word with any record; links can bring a neighbour that was not needed.

name: Lexical index
description: BASELINE: the field-weighted lexical hits of the specification index, each carried to the solution it belongs to.
advantages: The simplest free classifier; shows what following links adds.
disadvantages: A match on a problem or metric reaches its solution only when the record links it directly.
